newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah falls, stabilises in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah falls, stabilises in late trade.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah fell to a new low against the dollar before finding some temporary stabilisation in late trade, dealers said.
Spot rupiah slumped to a low of 2,960 before recovering to a 2,880/2,910 at 1000 GMT against an opening of 2,770/90.
Dealers said the fall was exacerbated by the wide spread, with rates jumping between 20 to 40 points if one price was hit.
"We saw increased commercial orders today. I think some corporates emerged to hedge their dollar positions as people are getting more nervous," one local bank dealer said.
